terms.title: Commercial terms
terms.intro: The defaults a new quote or order of this customer takes.
terms.saved: Commercial terms saved. Open quotes keep theirs; new quotes and orders take these.
terms.noList: None: priced from the base list
terms.typedOnly: Typed on the customer, not from the library
terms.noPrice: The minimum order value is not in your role (no selling prices).
terms.currencyHint: Its quotes and price list are in this currency.
terms.paymentHint: What is paid when; the deposit follows the order instalment.
terms.listHint: Active lists in {currency} of this company or every company.
terms.groupHint: Read only: a customer joins a discount group by getting the group's list (or a list that falls back to it).
terms.carrierHint: The carrier code its shipments use first (e.g. BRT, GLS).
terms.depositHint: Percent of the gross total; empty: from its payment terms, else the sales settings.
terms.minimumHint: Net, in {currency}; a quote under it says so.
terms.languageHint: The language its quotes, PDFs and mails are written in.
terms.invoicingHint: TD01 an invoice per shipment, TD24 one deferred invoice a month.
terms.choicesFailed: Couldn't read the payment terms or the price lists to pick from: the other fields still save.

held.archived: Archived: reactivate it to change its terms
held.noManage: Your role can see customers, not change them
held.noTerms: Your role cannot read the payment terms library
held.noListsManage: Giving a price list needs the right to keep price lists

problem.currency: A currency code such as EUR or CHF
problem.minimum: An amount with at most two decimals

refused.moved: Someone else changed this customer meanwhile: read again, nothing was overwritten.
refused.forbidden: Your role may not give this list or these terms.
refused.list: That price list cannot be this customer's: it must be active, of its company or every company, and in its currency.
refused.terms: Those payment terms cannot be used: archived, or of another company.
refused.currency: The currency does not fit its price list: change both together.
refused.fields: Some fields were refused: check them.
refused.unavailable: The server did not answer: nothing was changed, try again.
refused.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.

incoterm.CIP: CIP · Carriage and Insurance Paid To

held.manage: Your role can see customers, not change them
held.run: Importing needs the right to run imports and upload files

read.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
read.not_found: It is not there any more.
read.unavailable: The server did not answer: try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.contract: The answer did not match this page: reload the page.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

answer.nothingSet: nothing set yet: a new quote takes the sales settings
answer.noTerms: no payment terms set (a new quote takes the sales settings)
answer.fallback: The terms with each company could not be read: these are the customer's own terms.

chip.waitHold_one: {count} accepted quote waits for the hold
chip.waitHold_other: {count} accepted quotes wait for the hold
chip.waitPo_one: {count} accepted quote waits for a PO number
chip.waitPo_other: {count} accepted quotes wait for a PO number
chip.noIdentity: No tax identity: it cannot be invoiced
chip.viesInvalid: VIES: not valid — Italian VAT applies
chip.viesUnchecked: VAT number not checked with VIES

hold.none: Not on hold: new orders and shipments go ahead.

answer.every: On hold since {date}, for every company ({reason}).

stops.every: New orders and shipments of {customer} wait until the hold is released.
stops.with: New orders and shipments with {companies} wait until the hold is released.
stops.desc: Quotes go on, with a warning on each. Invoices and payments go on as usual.

hold.placedOnCheck: Placed on {date} by a credit check: “{words}”

com.answer: New quotes and orders take these; open ones keep their own.
com.shownFor: Shown for {company}, the company you work in; each company is below.
com.nothingSet: Nothing set yet: a new quote takes the sales settings' payment terms and deposit, in EUR and Italian, invoiced per shipment (TD01); we pay the freight.
com.ptNone: None: a new quote takes the sales settings
com.languageSub: Its quotes, PDFs and mails, when the contact has none
com.incotermSub: For Intrastat; a quote or order keeps its own
com.noService: No default service: picked per shipment
com.foot: What the customer sees: its portal Account page shows its payment terms and currency, read only, with “Something wrong? Ask us”.
com.footMulti: What the customer sees: its portal Account page shows the customer's own payment terms and currency, read only, with “Something wrong? Ask us”.

freight.COLLECT: The customer pays, on its own account (porto assegnato)
freight.THIRD_PARTY: Someone else pays, on their own account

co.backHeld: A credit limit is set with {company} (Money): its own terms stay while the limit is set.
